q: A tenderer sends his tender by post and it arrives late. The Railway:

options.A: May reject it; late tenders are not considered
options.C: Must award the work to him

q: True or False: A tenderer can revise his quoted rates after the due date on the ground of calculation error.

options.C: The statement is correct within 24 hours

q: Care in submission includes:

options.A: Submitting multiple tenders under different names
options.D: Checking that all required documents, certificates and bid security accompany the tender

q: Submitting more than one tender for the same work by the same tenderer (without provision):

options.A: May lead to rejection of his tenders

q: A tenderer must quote in the currency:

options.A: Specified in the tender documents (Indian Rupees)

q: True or False: Conditional tenders are normally liable to be rejected.
A tender with conditions contrary to the tender documents is:

options.D: Liable to be treated as non-responsive

q: The tenderer should retain:

options.B: A copy of his submitted tender for his record

q: Which of the following is NOT a part of 'care in submission'?
A careful tenderer, before quoting for a bridge work, would:

options.A: Copy rates from an unrelated work
options.B: Study the drawings, site conditions, lead of materials and special conditions

q: Annexure-V of the GCC is:

options.C: Format for Certificate to be submitted/uploaded by the tenderer along with the tender documents

q: Annexure-VI of the GCC contains:
Annexure-VIA of the GCC relates to:
Annexure-VIB of the GCC is:

options.A: Annual Contractual Turnover Data for the previous 3/4 years (contractual payment only)

q: The certificate in Annexure-V is submitted:

options.C: At the time of final bill
options.D: By the tenderer along with the tender documents

q: Bid Capacity of the tenderer is furnished in:
Turnover data for financial eligibility is furnished in:
True or False: Annexure-VIB covers contractual payments only, not other income.

options.A: The statement is correct only for JVs

q: Which annexure format is used for the bid security?
If the certificate in Annexure-V is found false after award, the consequence may be:

options.A: Termination with forfeiture and possible banning

q: The 'Bid Capacity' in Annexure-VI helps the Railway assess:

options.D: The tenderer's capability to execute the work

q: Which of the following is NOT an annexure of GCC Part I?
Annexure-VIB requires turnover data for:

options.C: The previous 3 financial years (or 4th previous year if the last is unaudited)

q: The turnover figures in Annexure-VIB must be:

options.B: Duly certified by a Chartered Accountant and supported by audited balance sheets

q: True or False: The formats in Annexures V, VI, VIA and VIB are mandatory and deviations may render the tender non-responsive.

options.B: The GCC has no such formats

q: Which annexure is titled 'Tenderer's Credentials'?
A tenderer submits Annexure-VIB showing only his total business income including trading income. This is:

options.C: Not correct; only contractual payments count

q: The certificate format in Annexure-V includes declarations about:

options.D: Correctness of information and documents submitted with the tender

q: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
Non-submission of the prescribed Annexure-VI (credentials) may lead to:

options.A: Refund of tender cost with bonus
options.C: Rejection of the tender as non-responsive
